classes: Things one above the other with the same space between each (spacing 4 unless a gap class says otherwise). Their own top and bottom margins are removed.
Things side by side that wrap onto the next line: buttons, tags, links (gap 3).
A cluster with its first and last parts at opposite ends.
A cluster aligned to the top, for parts of different heights.
A cluster aligned on the first line of text.
As many columns of at least 16rem as fit; one column on phones (gap 4). Set --ggds-grid-min to change the width.
Two columns from tablets; one on phones.
Two columns from tablets, three from desktops; one on phones.
Two columns from tablets, four from desktops; one on phones.
Main content with a 20rem side column from desktops (set --ggds-aside-width to change it); one column before (gap 8).
On desktops, stays in view while the page scrolls, clear of the header. For a side column.
In a cluster: takes the room left over.
In a cluster: keeps its own width.
In a grid or cluster: may shrink below its content, so long words and tables do not widen the page.
Pushes the last part of a card or column to its bottom edge.
The gap of a stack, cluster, grid or with-aside, from the spacing scale: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 or 12.
Space above, from the spacing scale: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 or 12. Prefer a stack.
Space inside, from the spacing scale: 0, 3, 4 or 6.
Space inside: spacing 4 on phones, 8 from tablets.
Text sizes from the type scale: xs, sm, base, lg, xl and 2xl (.ggds-text-sm and so on).
The size of a second-level heading.
Secondary text colour, still easy to read (4.5 to 1 or more).
The institution colour from its theme.
The monospace font, for reference numbers and codes.
Tight line height, for short text in cards and lists.
Keeps text on one line: dates, amounts.
The raised surface, for a box above the page.
The sunken surface, for a band or a box set into the page.
A light tint of the government blue.
Makes any of the borders above darker.
Fully rounded ends: a pill or a circle.
Hides what goes past its edges, so an image follows rounded corners.
An image or video that fills its box, cropped rather than stretched.
At least 44px tall, the GGDS touch target.
A 44px square with its content centred, for an icon button.
